_comment_token: Bot token from https://discord.com/developers/applications → your app → Bot. Treat as a secret.
_comment_channels: Discord channel IDs where the bot accepts triggers. Right-click a channel in Discord (with Developer Mode on) → 'Copy Channel ID'.
_comment_users: Discord user IDs allowed to trigger sessions. Right-click your username → 'Copy User ID'. ANY user not in this list is ignored.
_comment_workdir: Directory `claude -p` runs in. Make it whatever project you want to drive from Discord, e.g. /Users/junaidahmed/tradingagents.
_comment_claude: Absolute path to the claude binary. `which claude` if unsure.
_comment_timeout: Hard timeout (seconds) for a single claude invocation. 0 = no timeout. Default 1800 = 30 min.
_comment_concurrency: How many concurrent sessions are allowed across all users. 1 is safest on a workstation.
_comment_prefix: Optional command prefix. When set, only messages starting with this prefix trigger a session. Empty string = every message triggers.
